observations.behavior: Adds documentation for Vercel team transfer, including account and contact handling and billing preservation.
observations.code_quote: A Vercel user can move a Marketplace install, with its resources, to another Vercel team ([Vercel docs](https://vercel.com/docs/integrations/install-an-integration/transferring-an-integration)). The installation ID, its access token, the PostHog organization and its billing stay the same. Vercel enables transfers per integration, so ask in [#posthog-vercel](https://posthog.slack.com/archives/C08LYBQ58N5) before relying on them.
observations.posthog_connection: Supports marketplace customers transferring their Vercel-hosted PostHog installation to another Vercel team while retaining billing and account identity.

observations.behavior: Adds a GET endpoint to list billing plans for a Vercel resource; the plans are shared and do not depend on the resource.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog to retrieve and expose billing plan options to Vercel marketplace customers.
